sources.search_query: Singapore official immigration tourist visa requirements ICA
sources.relevant_excerpt: If you hold a travel document issued by one of the countries or places listed below, you will require a valid Singapore entry visa to travel to, and seek entry, into Singapore. [Listed countries/places:] Afghanistan, Algeria, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Bangladesh, Belarus, Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Egypt, Georgia, India, Iran, Iraq, Jordan, Kazakhstan, Kosovo, Kyrgyzstan, Lebanon, Libya, Mali, Moldova, Morocco, Nigeria, Pakistan, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, Tajikistan, Tunisia, Turkmenistan, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Yemen. [Also visa-required document types:] Refugee travel documents, Alien's passports, Palestinian Authority passports, temporary UAE passports, Hong Kong SAR Documents of Identity, Macao SAR Travel Permits, PRC Travel Documents. ICA does not accept submission of visa application over the immigration counters. Nationals of the Commonwealth of Independent States, Georgia, India, Turkmenistan and Ukraine; as well as selected Nationals of the People's Republic of China (PRC) ... may be eligible for the Visa-Free Transit Facility. A Singapore entry visa is not an immigration pass. [It is] pre-entry permission [and the] period of stay in Singapore is not tied to the validity of your visa; it is determined by the duration of the Visit Pass issued in the form of electronic visit pass (e-Pass) at the checkpoint upon entry.

sources.search_query: Singapore official immigration tourist visa requirements ICA
sources.relevant_excerpt: All visitors to Singapore must meet the following entry requirements: [a valid travel document with] minimum validity of 6 months at the time of departure, [confirmed onward/return tickets, sufficient funds, and] Visa for entry into Singapore (if applicable). The visa application form is available free of charge at all Singapore overseas missions. [Form 14A may be downloaded from ICA's website.] Visa application can be submitted online [through the SAVE system via a local Singapore contact who is a citizen or Permanent Resident].

sources.search_query: Singapore official immigration tourist visa requirements ICA
sources.relevant_excerpt: All travellers, except Singapore passport holders, must ensure their passport has a minimum validity of 6 months. Short-Term travellers should have sufficient cash and proof of onward travel (tickets, visas). All travellers are required to submit the SG Arrival Card within three (3) days (including the day of arrival) before arriving in Singapore. Short-Term travellers holding a passport or travel document from a visa-required country/region must apply for a Visa [or may use the Visa-Free Transit Facility for stays under 96 hours if eligible]. [Travellers must ensure they] do not stay beyond [their] Visit Pass validity.

sources.search_query: Singapore official immigration tourist visa requirements ICA
sources.relevant_excerpt: Your visa application can be submitted online using the e-Service through a strategic partner or a local contact in Singapore. Your visa application can be submitted at the nearest Singapore Overseas Mission or through its authorised visa agent. A S$30 non-refundable processing fee is payable online using a Visa or MasterCard credit/debit card. Your visa application will be processed within three working days (excluding the day of submission). Some applications may take longer to process. [The e-Service link points to /esvclandingpage/save (SAVE), accessible through MyICA.]

sources.relevant_excerpt: US Passport Holders (regular, official and diplomatic) do not require a visa to enter Singapore for business or for social visit purposes. The period of stay granted is shown on the visit pass endorsement given on your passport.

unresolved: Maximum stay for visa-free nationals (other than CHN's 30 days under the mutual arrangement) is not published by ICA as a per-nationality list; ICA/embassy pages state the period of stay is determined by the Visit Pass (e-Pass) granted at the checkpoint on entry (visit passes are typically issued for 14, 30 or 90 days per ICA extension pages, but no official per-country table was found). maximum_stay left null for those rows.
